_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `Puzzle3dMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third-party library reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none is authoritative over `Puzzle3dMutation` — the widest vocabulary in this plugin, spanning FOUR independent top-level collections (`objects`, `attractions`, `targetVolumes`, `references`) where an attraction names its endpoints as `object:vortex` pairs and a vortex lives inside an object, so `connect-vortices` and `disconnect-vortices` join two collections that have no containment relationship at all. That is this subset's own specification, not a fact an external 3d-scene library could confirm or refute. Confidence comes instead from the committed specification vectors under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<kind>/🧪️tests/<fixture>/` — one handcrafted `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintet per kind, already unit-tested inside the production crate — replayed end-to-end through the test platform here, plus two metamorphic laws asserted in role: observability (a kind must move the compared projection, or, where the committed outcome itself declares `mutation.no-op`, must provably move nothing) and footprint completeness (`before` and `after` may differ on exactly the fields the committed diff declares).
